about.title: About DALLFI
about.intro: DALLFI is a digital ecosystem where people and businesses build, work, connect, and grow together.
about.body1: We bring products, opportunities, talent, and professional services into one place so ideas can move from concept to reality faster.
about.body2: Our mission is to help founders, professionals, and organizations collaborate with clarity and create lasting impact.

membership.title: Membership
membership.intro: Join the DALLFI membership and unlock tools, community access, and growth opportunities.
membership.body1: Members get early access to ecosystem features, curated opportunities, and partner offers designed for builders and teams.
membership.body2: Choose a plan that matches your stage — from individuals exploring the ecosystem to organizations scaling across it.

partners.title: Partners
partners.intro: Partner with DALLFI to reach builders, talent, and businesses across the ecosystem.
partners.body1: We collaborate with service providers, platforms, educators, and investors who share our focus on practical growth.
partners.body2: Become a partner to co-create programs, distribute services, and support people turning ideas into reality.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Discover workshops, meetups, and ecosystem gatherings that help you build and connect.
events.body1: From product sessions to talent meetups, DALLFI events are designed to create useful conversations and real outcomes.
events.body2: Explore upcoming events and join sessions that match your goals in Build, Work, Connect, or Grow.

news.title: News
news.intro: Stay updated with product updates, partner announcements, and ecosystem stories.
news.body1: Follow the latest from DALLFI — launches, community highlights, and insights from people building in the ecosystem.
news.body2: Check back often for news that helps you stay ahead and find the next opportunity.

research.title: Research
research.intro: Insights and research on digital ecosystems, talent, and opportunity markets.
research.body1: We publish findings that help founders, professionals, and organizations make better decisions.
research.body2: Explore reports and briefings focused on growth, collaboration, and emerging opportunities.

careers.title: Careers
careers.intro: Build the future of DALLFI with a team focused on people, products, and opportunity.
careers.body1: We are looking for people who care about design, technology, community, and practical impact.
careers.body2: Browse open roles and join us in creating an ecosystem where ideas become reality.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Talk with the DALLFI team about partnerships, membership, press, or support.
contact.body1: Share your questions and we will guide you to the right next step in the ecosystem.
contact.body2: Whether you are a builder, partner, or organization, we are here to help you get started.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How DALLFI collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.body1: We are committed to transparency and responsible data practices across the ecosystem.
privacy.body2: Review this policy to understand your choices and how we handle personal information.
